# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface

## System and Application Header

- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by "Activities" button and desktop icons)
- **Application**: LibreOffice Impress
- **Window Title**: "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 23:09" displayed in the top bar
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the top-right corner, including sound, network, and power icons

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help
- **Toolbar Icons**: Located below the menu bar, including:
  - File operations (new, open, save, print)
  - Edit functions (cut, copy, paste)
  - View controls (zoom, view modes)
  - Drawing tools (shapes, lines, arrows, text boxes)
  - Object formatting tools (font, color, alignment)
  - Slide management tools (slide layout, master slide, slide show controls)

## Sidebar Panels

### Left Sidebar: Slides Panel

- **Slide Thumbnails**: Displays thumbnails of all 18 slides in the presentation
- **Current Slide**: Slide 1 is highlighted with a red border
- **Slide Titles**: Each thumbnail includes the slide title (e.g., "AGENDA", "BACKGROUND", "WHY STRATEGIC PLANNING?")
- **Slide Numbers**: Each thumbnail is labeled with its slide number (1 through 10 visible)
- **Navigation**: Vertical scroll bar on the right side of the panel

### Right Sidebar: Properties Panel

- **Panel Title**: "Properties"
- **Slide Properties Section**:
  - **Format**: "Widescreen" (dropdown menu)
  - **Orientation**: "Landscape" (dropdown menu)
  - **Background**: "None" (dropdown menu) with "Insert Image..." button
  - **Master Slide**: "Title Slide" (dropdown menu)
  - **Master Background**: Checkbox enabled
  - **Master Objects**: Checkbox enabled
  - **Master View**: Button to open Master View
- **Layouts Section**:
  - **Section Header**: "Layouts"
  - **Layout Grid**: 3 rows by 4 columns of layout thumbnails
  - **Selected Layout**: The second layout in the top row is highlighted with a red border
  - **Layout Icons**: Each icon represents a different slide layout with varying text and object placement

## Main Presentation Area

- **Slide Content**:
  - **Title**: "ASIS&T STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING" in large, bold, black text
  - **Subtitle**: "SEPTEMBER 29 and OCTOBER 1, 2015" in smaller black text
  - **Logo**: "asis&t" in red cursive font with "Association for Information Science and Technology" in smaller text below
- **Slide Border**: A thin gray border surrounds the slide content
- **Cursor**: A standard arrow cursor is visible over the slide content

## Top Notification Bar

- **Message**: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button
- **Message**: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button
- **Close Button**: "X" button to close the notification bar

## Status Bar

- **Slide Information**: "Slide 1 of 18"
- **Zoom Level**: "92%"
- **Language**: "English (USA)"
- **Measurement Units**: "6.27 / 1.32" and "0.00 x 0.00"
- **Zoom Slider**: Horizontal slider with a handle indicating the current zoom level
- **View Mode**: "Title Slide" displayed in the center of the status bar

## Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock**: Contains application icons including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help
  - Trash
- **Bottom Dock**: Contains a grid icon for application launcher
- **Top Bar**: Contains system indicators and application menu

## Additional UI Elements

- **Window Controls**: Minimize, maximize, and close buttons in the top-right corner
- **Scroll Bars**: Vertical scroll bar on the right side of the slides panel
- **Toolbar Icons**: Additional icons for slide management, formatting, and object manipulation
- **Notification Area**: Two informational banners at the top of the application window

## Slide Content Details

- **Title Text**: "ASIS&T STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING" with a red wavy underline
